scenario_contract.master_seed_derivation: stable integer from synthetic_release_v1, panel, split

task2.condition_rationale: queue_onset holds windows whose visible history has no queue and whose horizon does; queue_ongoing holds windows where a queue is already visible. Both require a queue in the horizon, which replaces the old minimum_transition_rate: without it a window with nothing queued and nothing predicted took the empty-union IoU of 1.0 as a free mark, which was 47.5% of the old normal condition, while another 27.5% scored exactly 0.0. Onset is solvable: an hour before a queue forms the road is already at 1.28x its queue threshold against 1.54x where none follows, and carries 6912 vph against 4620.
task2.window_count_rationale: Sample size only, not an anti-gaming threshold; the selector safeguards below carry that. Per-window IoU has a standard deviation of 0.3752 on the real validation persistence baseline (160 windows, 8 panels), so S_queue's per-panel standard error is 0.1187 at 5 windows against 0.0839 at 10. Across 8 panels at the 0.30 task weight that is 0.0126 of S_total against 0.0089, an increase of 0.0037. Reduced from 10 on 2026-09-01 because the synthetic corridor yields normal windows almost only at the morning peak onset and cannot reach 10.
